faq.title: Got Questions? We Have Answers.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about PDFMinty's private, in-browser PDF tools.

items.q: How does PdfMinty process my PDF files privately?
items.a: PdfMinty executes our standard PDF tools (merging, splitting, compressing, editing, signing) 100% locally inside your web browser using WebAssembly and client-side JavaScript without uploading files to any server. The only exception is the AI Analyze tool, which only sends extracted text to Google Gemini after you explicitly check a consent box.

items.q: Is PdfMinty completely free to use?
items.a: Yes, 100% free with no hidden fees, subscriptions, usage limits, or account registration required.

items.q: Do my files ever leave my computer or mobile device?
items.a: For our standard PDF tools, no — processing happens entirely in your local browser memory and works offline. The only exception is the AI Analyze tool, which only sends extracted text to Google Gemini after you explicitly check a consent box.

items.q: What file formats and PDF versions are supported?
items.a: PdfMinty supports standard PDF documents across all versions, including password-protected PDFs, scanned document pages, and standard image formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP) for PDF conversion.

items.q: How does PdfMinty compare to online converters like iLovePDF or Smallpdf?
items.a: Traditional PDF converters upload your confidential documents to external cloud servers to process them. PdfMinty processes standard tools locally on your own CPU and memory, eliminating privacy risks and server wait times.

grayscalePdf.guideLead: Converting high-resolution color PDF documents to pure monochrome (grayscale) is one of the most effective strategies for slashing file byte size, optimizing documents for bulk office printing, and preparing legal or academic filings according to strict publication guidelines.

grayscalePdf.algoText2: during page re-rasterization. This ensures that yellow highlights, subtle charts, and colored contrast text remain perfectly legible without muddying into solid black or washing out into white.

sanitizePdf.howToSanitize: How to Sanitize PDFs Securely in Your Browser
sanitizePdf.actionsDesc: This process permanently neutralizes embedded JavaScript, OpenAction triggers, and potentially harmful Launch actions hidden inside the PDF structure.
sanitizePdf.guideTitle: Understanding PDF Document Sanitization & Threat Neutralization
sanitizePdf.guideDesc: PDF documents are much more than static visual pages; they are structured, interactive binary containers capable of embedding executable JavaScript scripts, remote network triggers, automated form actions, and rich XML Metadata (XMP) packages. Sanitization is the process of inspecting and systematically purging hidden data layers and active elements to make documents safe for public release.
sanitizePdf.liJs: Embedded JavaScript & Triggers: Removes executable scripts attached to button clicks or page load triggers (/OpenAction, /JS).
sanitizePdf.liMeta: Hidden Metadata & XMP Packages: Strips camera GPS tags, revision histories, and author fingerprints.
sanitizePdf.liLaunch: External Launch Actions: Neutralizes commands that attempt to execute external software or open unverified URLs (/Launch).
sanitizePdf.liForm: Form Scripting & Stored Data: Clears unrendered calculation scripts and background tracking fields.
sanitizePdf.liLegal: Legal & Compliance Teams: Disclose filings and evidence without exposing draft revisions or privileged metadata.
sanitizePdf.liGov: Government & Whistleblowers: Protect the anonymity of reporters, researchers, and public servants.
sanitizePdf.liSec: Cybersecurity Officers: Disarm potentially weaponized PDF attachments before opening or distributing them to team members.
sanitizePdf.step1: Select File: Drag and drop your target document into the uploader above.
sanitizePdf.step2: Automatic Engine Analysis: Our WebAssembly engine scans the internal object dictionary for JavaScript, OpenAction hooks, and XMP streams.
sanitizePdf.step3: Download Clean Document: Download the sanitized, fully sterilized PDF with complete confidence.
sanitizePdf.offlineNotice: PdfMinty operates 100% inside your browser environment. Your confidential files are never transmitted across the network or stored in external databases, guaranteeing total data security and GDPR/HIPAA alignment.

adobeAlternative.faq0Q: Is PDFMinty really free, or is there a paid tier later?
adobeAlternative.faq0A: Every tool on PDFMinty is free with no account and no watermark. There's no hidden upgrade wall, monthly subscription, or credit-card required.
adobeAlternative.faq1Q: Do I need to sign up or install anything?
adobeAlternative.faq1A: No. Open the tool in your browser and use it. Nothing to download, nothing to register, and no background software daemons running on your machine.
adobeAlternative.faq2Q: Where do my files go when I use PDFMinty?
adobeAlternative.faq2A: Nowhere but your own device for standard PDF tools. Processing happens locally in your browser memory via WebAssembly without cloud file uploads.
adobeAlternative.faq3Q: Can PDFMinty fully replace Adobe Acrobat?
adobeAlternative.faq3A: For merging, splitting, compressing, rotating, watermarking, password protection, metadata sanitization, and image/PDF conversion — yes, for virtually all everyday office tasks. If you strictly require commercial prepress CMYK color separations, legacy XFA dynamic forms, or hardware PKI smartcards, retain Acrobat.
adobeAlternative.faq4Q: Is a browser-based tool as safe as a desktop app?
adobeAlternative.faq4A: Since your file never leaves your device, there's no upload step and no server storing a copy of your document — see our related post on PDF tool security for the full picture, including the limits of that claim.
adobeAlternative.faq5Q: Does PDFMinty work when offline or on an airplane?
adobeAlternative.faq5A: Yes! PDFMinty is built as a Progressive Web App (PWA). Once loaded in your browser, its WebAssembly engine and scripts are cached by the browser Service Worker, allowing full offline execution without Wi-Fi.
adobeAlternative.faq6Q: Are electronic signatures made on PDFMinty legally valid?
adobeAlternative.faq6A: Yes. Under the US ESIGN Act and EU eIDAS regulations for Simple Electronic Signatures (SES), signatures drawn and flattened directly into documents carry full legal enforceability for standard agreements and NDAs.
adobeAlternative.faq7Q: How does client-side compression achieve up to 80% file size reduction?
adobeAlternative.faq7A: By converting heavy color profiles to grayscale, resampling raster images to high-density screen resolutions, and applying lossless Flate stream compression entirely in local browser memory.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.updated: Last Updated & Reviewed: September 2026 • Technical Reviewer: Security & Compliance Architecture Team
privacyPolicy.summary: PdfMinty's standard 22 PDF tools process files 100% locally inside your web browser without uploading your documents to any server. Your document contents never leave your device. If you explicitly choose to use the opt-in AI PDF Assistant (/ai-analyze-pdf), extracted text is sent securely via encrypted API to Google Gemini to fulfill your query, strictly after you give consent. Below you will also find detailed disclosures regarding Google AdSense advertising cookies, analytics, and your international privacy rights.
privacyPolicy.sec1Desc: When you select a PDF file in standard PdfMinty tools (merge, split, rotate, compress, protect, watermark, convert, delete pages, reorder, etc.), it is processed entirely using client-side WebAssembly, JavaScript, and Web Workers in your browser memory on your local machine or mobile device.
privacyPolicy.sec2Desc: We do not maintain backend servers or cloud storage buckets that store, cache, or buffer your PDF documents. All binary file transformations execute entirely within your device's RAM. When you close the browser tab or refresh the page, all file data is completely purged from memory.
privacyPolicy.sec3Desc: PdfMinty offers an optional AI PDF Assistant. If you select a file and check the explicit consent checkbox in the AI tool, extracted text from up to the first 12 pages is transmitted over an encrypted TLS connection to Google Gemini API to answer your questions or generate summaries. Binary PDF files are never stored, and text is transmitted solely for processing your immediate query.

We do not sell user data, track individual personal identities, or store cookies containing sensitive document data.

privacyPolicy.sec6Li1: Right of Access & Deletion: Because standard PDF operations do not collect or store user accounts, identities, or files, there is no personally identifiable file data retained on our servers to access or delete.
privacyPolicy.sec6Li2: Do Not Sell My Information: PdfMinty does not sell, rent, or monetize your personal information or document contents to any third parties.
